title: He Confessed. Then the Judge Spoke. (Bernie Madoff)

lines.say: March twelfth, two thousand nine. A federal courtroom in Manhattan. Bernard Madoff stands up and reads a confession.
lines.show: March 12, 2009. A federal courtroom in Manhattan. Bernard Madoff stands up and reads a confession.

lines.say: To the best of my recollection, my fraud began in the early nineteen nineties.
lines.show: "To the best of my recollection, my fraud began in the early 1990s."

scene.q: To the best of my recollection, my fraud began in the early 1990s.

lines.say: His clients believed their money was in the stock market. It wasn't.
I never invested those funds in the securities, as I had promised. Instead, those funds were deposited in a bank account at Chase Manhattan Bank.

scene.q: I never invested those funds in the securities, as I had promised. Instead, those funds were deposited in a bank account at Chase Manhattan Bank.

lines.say: He pleaded guilty to all eleven counts.
lines.show: He pleaded guilty to all 11 counts.

lines.say: June twenty-ninth. Judge Denny Chin called his crimes extraordinarily evil.
lines.show: June 29. Judge Denny Chin called his crimes "extraordinarily evil."

lines.say: The sentence: one hundred fifty years in prison. The maximum.
lines.show: The sentence: 150 years in prison. The maximum.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
